title: Late-Fee Floor Scale by Rent Charged: Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement
content:
The late-fee floor on a Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement follows the rent charged for the period:

| Rent charged for the period | Late-fee floor |
|---|---|
| under $100 | $10 |
| $100 or more but under $200 | $15 |
| $200 or more | the class's flat late-fee floor |

The rent charged is the period's rent charge entry on the agreement's ledger, as billed.

## Class flat floors used in the top band

| Unit class | Flat late-fee floor |
|---|---|
| Bluegate Drive-Up Standard | $20 |
| Bluegate Interior Standard | $20 |
| Bluegate Climate Controlled | $25 |
| Bluegate Climate Plus | $25 |
| Bluegate Premier Climate Suite | $30 |
| Bluegate Wine & Collectibles Vault | $30 |

## Band edges (hypothetical rent charges)

| Rent charged | Floor |
|---|---|
| $99.99 | $10 |
| $100.00 | $15 |
| $199.99 | $15 |
| $200.00 | class flat floor, for example $25 in the Bluegate Climate Controlled class |

## Basis questions

- *A Bluegate Interior Standard period charged $64.50?* The floor is $10.
- *A Bluegate Wine & Collectibles Vault period charged $310.00?* The floor is the class's flat floor, $30.
